name: Spirkelbach (Germany)
description: Quartered white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Spirkelbach (an eagle, a lion and a wavy bend).
history: Municipal flag of Spirkelbach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Spirkelbach arms — eagle, lion and wavy bend
